1.purpose: A dense frieze of tiny silhouettes (~1/12 of the frame) fighting along a bright water line under a diffuse sun glow.
1.artefacts: Figures too small and packed; no sun disk.

2.purpose: S18 v2: a continuous fighting line in crisp silhouette along a flat horizon (v 0.868) against a big low sun; pairs and groups thrust, clash, swing and grapple across the whole width; sparse for ~0.7 s, then full.

2.artefacts: The plate's sun sits on the horizon behind the fighters (S18 keys the silhouettes and paints its own sun higher).
